Operator design-era description of the 16 m, three-storey terminal and central rainforest atrium. The exact present internal layout is not surveyed.

geometry_changes.NS_Square: Exact construction parcel ground reconstruction with reservoir water and racing corridors excluded. Pale street-facing hoarding replaces a generic future building. Height and support pitch are unmeasured scene estimates.
geometry_changes.Ritz_Carlton: Actual 19-point tower part 326926564 at 140 m, three mapped support parts and the mapped podium. The 37 m support clearance follows the owner; OSM min_height/BCA first-floor evidence around 30 m is retained as a 30–37 m source discrepancy. Exact facade/window spacing, vault section and support detailing are reconstructions.
geometry_changes.Ritz_driveway: Exact connected OSM paths 620797981/784662624/741167072 rise from the race avenue toward the Level 3 lobby. An estimated 8±2 m rise is modeled above the bounded front garden; neither the raised access nor the entire large commercial parcel is flattened.
geometry_changes.ground_frontage: The reconstructed low garden is 5,422 m², only 1.66% of commercial parcel 1163299805. Actual street parcel edge and mapped podium front bound it; lateral ends extend about 10 m beyond the podium and remain estimates.
geometry_changes.Flyer: Terminal-roof DSM no longer adds about 11 m to the wheel foundation. A bounded terminal/plaza ground estimate is tied to the adjacent road. The hub is derived so the 150 m rim and 4 m capsule envelope fit the 165 m operator overall height. Rim/spokes use private dark structural material; actual white legs and capsule caps remain. The terminal has three levels and an estimated central roof opening clearing the lower capsule path.
geometry_changes.vegetation: Grounded street-side broadleaf canopies match the direct 1250.81 s context, avoiding mapped buildings, the rising driveway, water and all racing arms. Individual placements and heights remain visual estimates.

reference.registration: Wheel identity, road direction, near-wall canopy, Aramco bands and urban construction context. Camera registration is approximate, ±100 m; no elapsed-time interpolation is used.

physical_contract: New ground and buildings are scenery beyond the protected race corridor. No native road XYZ, width, banking or driveable escape extent changes. Earlier event-corner station remapping remains separately documented.
remaining_limits: No structural survey establishes the Ritz 30–37 m lower clearance conflict or exact podium/driveway heights.
The terminal atrium outline, facade rhythms, support sizes, garden lateral ends and construction hoarding height are estimated.
Actual current cockpit views and Luna High review are still required after generation/import.
